chars.BATOUL: BATOUL: a young woman wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, light-blue jeans, small gold hoop earrings and white sneakers.
chars.ANAS: ANAS: a young man wearing a red Morocco football jersey with a green collar and black tracksuit trousers.
chars.KHALID: KHALID: a tall young man wearing an olive-green bomber jacket over a white T-shirt and beige chinos.
chars.MAMA: MAMA: a middle-aged woman wearing a long dark-purple djellaba and a beige headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In the entrance hall of a modern Casablanca apartment, ANAS opens the front door and brings in his friend KHALID; BATOUL stands frozen in the hallway, surprised, staring at KHALID, and KHALID looks back at her. Tension, surprise.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: ANAS and KHALID sit side by side on a traditional Moroccan salon sofa with patterned cushions, cheering with raised fists in front of a TV showing a football match, snacks and mint tea on a low round table.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a small Moroccan kitchen with tiles, MAMA pours mint tea from a silver teapot while BATOUL leans on the counter looking toward the living room door with curiosity. A framed family photo with a black ribbon on the wall.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: BATOUL sits on her bed in her bedroom at night with the door slightly open, leaning toward the door to listen to men's voices and laughter coming from the living room, curious.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the living room, ANAS shows BATOUL the screen of his phone with a photo of a young man; BATOUL leans in to look closely, eyebrows raised, interested.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Match day: BATOUL walks into the living room; KHALID stands up politely from the Moroccan sofa to greet her with a hand on his chest; ANAS sits on the sofa holding a small Moroccan flag, TV on in the background.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: All three watch the football match on the Moroccan sofa; ANAS shouts at the TV, KHALID watches the match, and BATOUL secretly glances at KHALID with a shy smile and blushing cheeks.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the apartment hallway, BATOUL eagerly asks ANAS something with excited hands clasped together, while ANAS, holding a glass of tea, looks at her puzzled and suspicious with one eyebrow raised.
